title: VBCDX overlay declaration (vbcdx-overlay.json)
description: Shipped at the root of an overlay directory. An overlay adds a team's rules to the roles of the agent packs it names without forking them: variable values, text appended to every role (all.md) or one role (roles/<id>.md), and replacements for a prompt's named slots (slots/<name>.md for every role, slots/<role>/<name>.md for one). Every file is optional; each must be non-empty text. The rules that need the packs (a named pack is loaded, a variable or slot exists, a role exists) are checked by the reference loader (src/overlays/overlay.js).

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors: a relative path ending in vbcdx-overlay.schema.json.

name.description: The overlay's short name, shown in reports. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

version.description: The overlay's version, recorded with every file it shaped.

description.description: Optional one line saying what the overlay is for.

packs.description: The agent packs (by their vbcdx-pack.json name) whose roles the overlay applies to. Each must be loaded.

vars.description: Values for variables the named packs declare (vbcdx-pack.json vars): one line of printable text each.

rename.description: Optional. Install a pack role under a local id instead of its own: {"<pack role id>": "<local id>"}. The role keeps the pack's prompt and descriptor; its id and credential suffix become the local id, which this overlay's files (roles/<id>.md, slots/<role>/) also use. The local id must not be a role of any loaded pack.
